P1.evidence: No setter notes were read back - 'I don't have a ton of information about you, so I'm curious'. The frame ran two of four parts: 'we're going to go deep in terms of what you've got going on with your fitness right now and what you're looking to accomplish' - nothing about what is in the way or what he needs. Frame agreement was taken and given ('if that sounds good' / 'Yeah, fine'), and the open question was asked cleanly: 'what would you say is the biggest challenge that you're having with your health and fitness right now?' Worth noting the prospect rejected the premise - 'I don't really look at it like that. I would say I'm in a good place' - and the rep did not adapt the frame to an optimizer.

P2.evidence: Weight and body fat were asked - 'where are you sitting at right now in terms of weight or body fat, and I guess what are you looking to cut down to?' - but age and height were never asked at any point. Occupation was never asked; the financial-markets detail was volunteered inside an answer about Lisbon, which the script scores as a miss. Health conditions were never asked. Injuries were asked - 'are you in any pain now, or is that more so like looking to prevent it in the future?' - which surfaced an active deltoid issue under physiotherapy, but there was no follow-up on duration, restriction or clearance, so the check is incomplete. Training week was covered well (four gym days, hour sessions, previously three days with a PT) and results from current training were explored in detail through the two cuts. Diet was only touched obliquely by asking whether the PT handles nutrition; what he actually eats was never asked. Sleep and energy were never asked - sleep appears only as something Trevor would assess after purchase.

P3.evidence: The surface layer was handled well: 'are you trying to get more defined, more muscular or more like a six pack' produced the stubborn belly and love handles, and the later goal question produced 'stronger, more mobile'. The bridge question was asked properly - 'what's behind you wanting to get down to a six pack and get cut and really focus on this, especially while traveling and working abroad?' - and produced real material: his work in the markets, and 'I want to be able to look in the mirror and be proud of that achievement.' That last line is an identity answer and it was the moment to go deeper; instead the rep lost his place - 'said something interesting. So basically, um, Lost track of my train of thought' - and pivoted to sports and hobbies. Nobody asked who else this impacts, and there was no drive through to family, marriage, legacy or longevity at any point on a 39-minute call. The reflect-back at 00:16:52 was a feature list ('number one, start having a different workout... more functional... dialing in the nutrition... someone to keep you accountable') rather than 'this isn't really about the weight, it's about X'.

P4.evidence: Past attempts and what happened were covered thoroughly - two previous PTs, one cut that got close, and the follow-up 'when you say it slipped, like how come it slipped?' The prospect answered with self-blame: 'It's, it's, it's my fault. Cause I let go of the focus of it. I went over to focus on my work.' That is precisely the moment the script exists for, and the rep accepted the self-blame rather than reframing it as a structural gap - no 'the information isn't the problem, why can't you stick to it on your own', and no naming of the real gap, which the transcript actually hands over: his structure has twice collapsed on relocation, and he is about to relocate again. That connection was never made.

P5.evidence: Not run in any form. No two-year question, no 'willing to settle', no 'why not', no line in the sand. This is the second consecutive call in this batch where the entire 20-point Consequence Frame is absent, and here it was unusually cheap to run - the prospect had already volunteered the regret ('I look back at that and I think, oh, it's frustrating because I sort of got near to it, but didn't just do that last part of the journey') and the imminent move to Lisbon was a ready-made two-year frame.

P6.evidence: Better than most of the batch on sequencing - the rep did run qualification before quoting: time commitment ('do you have at least two to three hours a week'), coachability, an outcome question, and then the belief question in near-scripted form: 'based off what you know about our process and what you've seen with Trevor, do you feel like that plan I just walked you through can, can get you there?' The answer was 'Yeah, potentially' - a hedge, not a yes. He probed it once, correctly ('when you say potentially, is there any part that you're unsure about?'), got the online-versus-in-person doubt, then misread it as money ('Yeah. So the finances then?'), was corrected, and moved to price anyway. The all-in question was never asked, and the script's instruction to return to Phase 5 on hesitation was not followed.

P11.evidence: No close was attempted. Price was quoted in response to a direct request and the rep never asked for the business afterwards - the next move was 'Okay. Well, where would you like to go from here?' followed by agreeing to a callback. With no close attempt the phase drops out of the denominator, but the absence of an ask on a prospect who raised no price objection is the headline coaching point and is captured in the notes.

objection_plays.detail: Trigger was explicit: 'I just need to go away and have a think about it.' The rep had already banked the first scripted move pre-emptively - 'do you feel like that plan I just walked you through can get you there?' - and followed the hedge with a correct probe. After the deferral landed, though, nothing else ran: no 'what makes you feel it can', no 'what's actually coming up that's preventing you from getting started', no 'thinking isn't the problem, deciding is', no decision-identity move, no final 'are you sure'. He explored the shape of the decision and then scheduled a callback, which is where the play should have started, not ended.

Trigger was 'I'm not in a rush to make a decision today... over the next couple of weeks, I need to decide how I'm going to adapt my training program', reinforced by wanting to speak to the Portugal PT first. No scripted move ran - no 'when does it actually become the right time', no 'things never slow down', no compounding-cost frame. The rep adopted the prospect's timeline wholesale and set the follow-up inside it.

No money objection arose. The rep briefly guessed at one - 'Yeah. So the finances then?' - and was corrected: 'No, just like say, whether I want to still be working with someone in person.' Inventing a money objection where none existed is a minor misread worth coaching, but there was no trigger to play against.
No spousal or partner consult was raised. Family status was never explored at all.
No fear or doubt objection surfaced.

The central objection on this call has no scripted play: a stated preference for in-person delivery, held by someone who has only ever been coached in person and describes himself as a perfectionist about form. 'I don't think you can beat someone being there physically and keeping a closer eye.' The script has no answer for online-versus-in-person, and the rep's improvisation actively argued the prospect out of buying: 'if you want to be there with somebody in person obviously that's not what this program is so it definitely make more sense to just work with somebody in person.' This is a script gap, not a rep failure, and it is the second distinct gap category in this batch after 'a cheaper alternative already worked'. Note the prospect had already supplied the bridge himself - 'the next best thing with online is videoing it and having that feedback' - and said he would do both 'without a doubt', so the winnable position was complement-not-replace and nobody took it.

notes: Best-sequenced call of the batch so far - qualification ran before the quote - but it ends with no ask on the cleanest ICP fit and the only prospect with zero price resistance. Two things to coach: never concede a competing modality the prospect has already offered to run alongside you, and when a prospect discloses an injury under active physiotherapy, stop and establish clearance before describing progressive loading.
